That's the reading flow just as I pictured it. I hit "Read later" on the water-cities one and it dropped into its own pile; the "Read later" section gave me a clean, focused list of just the things I've set aside; and when I checked one off with that round button, it left the pile and the count ticked down — but back in the main Library the bookmark was still sitting there, safe. That last part matters to me: "I've read this" shouldn't mean "throw it away." It just means clear it off my to-read stack.

Having it as a standing section I can pop into whenever I've got time, rather than something I have to set up each visit, is exactly right too.

Reading workflow's good. What's next?
